name: brydge-team-skills
description: Brydge Group's vetted skills and plugins for client teams. Our own plugins live in ./plugins; third-party plugins are referenced from their original source and never copied.

plugins.name: brydge-essentials
plugins.description: For every team: write emails, review emails before sending, and build HTML slide decks.

plugins.name: brydge-comms
plugins.description: Turn one piece of content into newsletters, Instagram and Facebook posts and a posting calendar; translate and localise posts; keep a brand voice; make charts.

plugins.name: brydge-creative
plugins.description: Generate and edit images with Google Gemini (needs a free Google AI key) and design web pages that do not look AI-generated.

plugins.name: brydge-inbox
plugins.description: Opt-in. Inbox triage, email deliverability checks (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and compliance scans. Needs a mail connection; install brydge-essentials too.

plugins.name: xlsx
plugins.description: Anthropic. Create, read and edit Excel spreadsheets with formulas and formatting.

plugins.name: docx
plugins.description: Anthropic. Create and edit Word documents, including tracked changes and comments.

plugins.name: pptx
plugins.description: Anthropic. Create and edit PowerPoint presentations.

plugins.name: pdf
plugins.description: Anthropic. Read, fill, merge, split and create PDF files.

plugins.name: internal-comms
plugins.description: Anthropic. Staff updates, newsletters, status reports and FAQs in a consistent house format.

plugins.name: canvas-design
plugins.description: Anthropic. Posters and one-page visual designs exported as PNG or PDF.

plugins.name: discernment-nudge
plugins.description: Anthropic. Adds two or three short questions after a substantive answer so you check the facts before you use it.

plugins.name: academy-guide
plugins.description: Anthropic. Points you to the right Claude Academy course or tutorial when you ask how to do something.

plugins.name: skill-creator
plugins.description: Anthropic. Build your own skill step by step, then test and improve it.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Anthropic. Distinctive, production-quality web pages and components.

plugins.name: playwright
plugins.description: Microsoft, via Anthropic's directory. Lets Claude open a browser, click through a website, fill forms and take screenshots.

plugins.name: firecrawl
plugins.description: Firecrawl. Read, search and crawl websites. Needs a Firecrawl API key.

plugins.name: canva
plugins.description: Canva. Create, resize and brand-check Canva designs. Needs a Canva account.

plugins.name: last30days
plugins.description: Matt Van Horn. What people said about a topic in the last 30 days on Reddit, Hacker News, YouTube and more.

plugins.name: anti-slop
plugins.description: Daniel Agrici. Reviews drafts for generic AI-sounding writing and reports what to fix. Runs a Python check after every file write.
